links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses versus prompted sixth-grade reading level
links.effect: Only 3 of 15 responses (20%) were at or below sixth-grade level; mean Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level 6.94, Gunning Fog 9.22 (seventh grade to early high school).
links.quote: Yet only 3 ChatGPT responses (20%) were at or below a sixth-grade reading level, as prompted.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated parent education answers
links.effect: Providers rated answers satisfactory and 100% agreed reading level was appropriate, but objective scores showed only 20% of responses at or below sixth grade.
links.quote: A majority of providers agreed that these responses would be sufficient for most parents (56%) and that the information was at the appropriate reading level (100%).

screen.reason: The study directly tests whether prompting ChatGPT with a reading-level constraint (asking for a response at or below a sixth-grade reading level) successfully achieves the desired readability level for patient education, evaluating readability with standard formulas and clinician review.
